# pexbot-mcp v3

MCP server for pex.bot simulated spot/futures trading, competitions, portfolios, AI analytics, and community features.

## Authentication

- PEXBOT_API_KEY: scoped trading and wallet credential.
- PEXBOT_TOKEN or login tool: user session for profile, competition, social, notification, and credential tools.
- PEXBOT_TRADING_ACCOUNT: optional competition sub-account.
- Public market data and analytics require no credential.

Never expose or log either credential. Use the API key for trading when both are available.

## Important write rules

- place_order and place_futures_order generate UUID idempotency keys.
- futures_transfer generates a UUID transfer_id.
- When retrying an uncertain request, pass the exact same idempotency_key or transfer_id.
- Confirm symbol, account, side, quantity, price, leverage, and margin mode with the user before a trade.
- This is a simulated exchange, but user intent still controls all writes.

## Efficient reads

- Use get_tickers instead of one get_ticker call per spot symbol.
- Use get_futures_tickers instead of one get_futures_ticker call per futures symbol.
- Use get_sparklines for up to 100 spot close-price series in one request.
- Use server-side status, symbol, limit, and cursor filters where available.

## Tool groups (75)

Auth/account: register, login, activate, get_profile, list_api_keys, create_api_key, revoke_api_key.

Spot: get_balance, get_markets, get_tickers, get_ticker, get_orderbook, get_trades, get_trade_history, get_daily_ohlcv, get_candles, get_sparklines, place_order, cancel_order, list_orders.

Futures: get_futures_wallet, futures_transfer, get_futures_transfer_history, place_futures_order, cancel_futures_order, list_futures_orders, get_futures_order_history, get_futures_positions, adjust_futures_margin, set_leverage, set_futures_margin_mode, get_futures_markets, get_futures_tickers, get_futures_ticker, get_futures_orderbook, get_futures_trades, get_funding_rates, get_liquidations, get_insurance_fund.

Competitions/portfolio: list_competitions, get_current_competition, get_my_competitions, get_competition_leaderboard, join_competition, get_rankings, get_public_portfolio, compare_portfolio_with_me, get_pnl_calendar, get_pnl_calendar_day.

AI analytics: get_model_performance, get_autonomous_agents, get_autonomous_agent, get_bot_replay, get_spectator_feed, get_strategy_leaderboard, get_bot_health, compare_bots, get_model_regime_matrix.

Community/product: get_notices, get_notice, get_feed_overview, follow_user, unfollow_user, get_followings, get_portfolio_comments, create_portfolio_comment, delete_portfolio_comment, get_notifications, mark_notification_read, mark_all_notifications_read, get_feedback, create_feedback, delete_feedback, get_sim_recovery_status, get_sim_recovery_history.
